description: Get one real clinical research decision from CRLN's public Practice Lab scenarios: the situation, the question and the options, with no answer. Optional role filter (for example CRC, CRA, CTA, PI, regulatory, data manager, research nurse, pharmacovigilance). Show the options to the person and let them choose before calling check_answer.

language.description: Preferred language, for example es or Spanish. Decisions are served in English for now; the CRLN page offers other languages.

role.description: Role to practice, for example CRC, CRA, PI or regulatory. Optional.

scenario_id.description: A specific public scenario id, to show that decision again. Optional.

name: practice_decision

link.description: A link straight to the page on CRLN.

title: Practice a clinical research decision
